WITH eligible_accounts AS (
    SELECT a.account_id
    FROM main.account AS a
    JOIN main.district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN (
        SELECT p.account_id
        FROM main.disp AS p
        JOIN main.card AS c ON c.disp_id = p.disp_id
        WHERE p.type = 'OWNER' AND c.type = 'gold'
        GROUP BY p.account_id
    ) AS g ON g.account_id = a.account_id
    WHERE CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 250000
)
SELECT t.operation,
       typeof(t.date) AS date_storage,
       MIN(t.date) AS first_date,
       MAX(t.date) AS last_date,
       COUNT(*) AS debit_count,
       SUM(t.bank IS NULL OR t.bank = '') AS missing_bank,
       SUM(t.account IS NULL OR t.account = '') AS missing_counter_account,
       MIN(t.amount) AS minimum_amount,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM eligible_accounts) AS eligible_accounts,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.district AS d WHERE d.A4 = '' OR d.A4 GLOB '*[^0-9]*') AS non_digit_populations
FROM main.trans AS t
JOIN eligible_accounts AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
WHERE t.type = 'VYDAJ'
GROUP BY t.operation, typeof(t.date)
ORDER BY t.operation

WITH recipient_totals AS (
    SELECT t.bank AS recipient_bank_code,
           t.account AS recipient_counter_account,
           COUNT(*) AS outgoing_payment_count,
           SUM(t.amount) AS total_paid
    FROM main.trans AS t
    JOIN main.account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
    JOIN main.district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    WHERE t.date >= '1998-01-01'
      AND t.date < '1999-01-01'
      AND t.type = 'VYDAJ'
      AND t.bank IS NOT NULL
      AND t.bank <> ''
      AND t.account IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(d.A4 AS INTEGER) >= 250000
      AND a.account_id IN (
          SELECT p.account_id
          FROM main.disp AS p
          JOIN main.card AS c ON c.disp_id = p.disp_id
          WHERE p.type = 'OWNER'
            AND c.type = 'gold'
      )
    GROUP BY t.bank, t.account
)
SELECT recipient_bank_code,
       recipient_counter_account,
       outgoing_payment_count,
       total_paid
FROM recipient_totals
WHERE total_paid = (SELECT MAX(total_paid) FROM recipient_totals)
ORDER BY recipient_bank_code, recipient_counter_account
